_source: claude-api skill model table (cached 2026-09-25, read 2026-10-04; the Fable 5.2 row from the table cached 2026-11-03, read 2026-11-20; the Haiku 5.5 row (up to 100K-token prompts, cache read 0.1x input; longer prompts cost $0.50 in, $2.50 out, not modelled) and the Mythos 5.2 row (same model and price as Fable 5.2) from the same skill's models.md and model-migration.md, read 2026-11-20). Gateway models (free OmniRoute chain) cost kuhy nothing and are priced 0. USD per million tokens. Cache writes are priced as multiples of input: 5m = 1.25x, 1h = 2x (verified 2026-10-04: a claude -p probe's total_cost_usd matched opus-5-5 at 2x for its 1h write to 7 digits). Entries marked assumed_cache_read use the standard 0.1x-of-input ratio because the table does not list them.
